Eurostat fixtures (HICP, dataset `prc_hicp_minr`), fetched 2026-11-02 with a
`Mizan/<version>` User-Agent and no key.

- `hicp_ea_tr.json`: real response to
  `.../data/prc_hicp_minr?format=JSON&geo=EA&geo=TR&unit=I15&coicop18=TOTAL&sinceTimePeriod=2026-05`.
- `unknown_geo.json`: real response for an unknown `geo` (no values), with the
  time dimension trimmed to three months and the long extension metadata removed.
